items.title: Generac (GNRC) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of power generation products company Generac (NYSE:GNRC) jumped 2.5% in the afternoon session after the company posted strong second-quarter results, highlighting significant demand from data center customers.

items.title: Ingersoll Rand Beats Q2 Earnings Estimates, Raises Revenue Guidance
items.summary: IR beats Q2 earnings and revenue estimates, raises its 2026 sales outlook and reports stronger orders, cash flow and M&A momentum.

items.title: Down 24% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why Generac Holdings (GNRC) Looks Ripe for a Turnaround
items.summary: Generac Holdings (GNRC) has become technically an oversold stock now, which implies exhaustion of the heavy selling pressure on it. This, combined with strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in revising earnings estimates higher, indicates a potential trend reversal for the stock in the near term.

items.title: GNRC Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center Backlog Fuels Commercial Segment Expansion
items.summary: Power generation products company Generac (NYSE:GNRC) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 10.6% year on year to $1.17 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.91 per share was 44.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Flowserve's Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Margin Expansion, Bookings Up Y/Y
items.summary: FLS beats Q2 earnings estimates as margin expansion and record aftermarket bookings offset lower sales, while raising the low end of its 2026 EPS outlook.

items.title: Cimpress Beats Q4 Earnings Estimates on Revenue Growth, Issues FY2027 View
items.summary: CMPR beats Q4 earnings estimates on broad-based revenue growth and issues fiscal 2027 guidance with higher revenue and profitability targets.

items.title: Tetra Tech Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Core Market Growth
items.summary: TTEK beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates as backlog grew on new project wins, with strength in water infrastructure, defense and digital automation.

items.title: A. O. Smith Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Boiler Growth, Pricing
items.summary: AOS beats Q2 earnings and sales estimates, boosted by North America strength, while higher input costs and weaker China demand pressured profitability.
